Grander Stories

 

Bringing the hope of Christ to the academy
 

 

 

We're a community of professors, for professors
 

The world desperately needs your God-given calling. In Faculty Commons, we understand the immense challenges you face as you seek to thrive in today’s academy. We’re here to help you find the encouragement, resources, and community that you need. Come play your unique part in God’s grander story!
 

See what we are about

"Amid the incessant pressure of grant deadlines, grading, prepping new lectures, and tweaking my curriculum vitae, it’s easy to forget that I am part of a grand story being written by the living Christ. The team at Faculty Commons resources and encourages me to live out my role in God’s story on my campus."
 

Jeff Hardin, 
Raymond E. Keller Professor, 
Department of Integrative Biology, 
University of Wisconsin—Madison
 

Want more encouraging stories from your peers?
 

Get encouragement and wisdom written by professors for professors sent weekly during the school year (look for “Missional Moments” in your inbox).
